At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are looking for a Business Systems Architect (m/f/d) to own and evolve the systems, tools, and processes that keep TYTAN running. As a company that designs and manufactures its own hardware and software, our operational landscape spans engineering, production, supply chain, and beyond, all of which need to be reflected in a coherent, well-connected tool and process architecture. Systems Architecture & Roadmap

- Build and maintain the enterprise architecture across business capabilities, processes, data, and applications, building a lean digital thread from Requirements and Engineering through to Production and Service.
- Define and enforce standards across the stack: single source of truth, SSO, clean integrations, and compliance with ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and Export Control requirements.
- Anticipate when the current tool landscape needs to evolve, knowing when Odoo alone is not enough and when dedicated PLM, MES, or other systems are needed.

Odoo Development & Customization

- Configure, customize, and extend Odoo modules using Python to match evolving business needs, owning upgrades, testing, and deployment across environments.
- Ensure data integrity, security, and performance of the Odoo platform while managing integrations with tools across CRM, finance, project management, and communication.

Engineering, Production & Process

- Work with stakeholders to map, document, and improve business processes eliminating bottlenecks, reducing manual workarounds, and maintaining documentation as the business evolves.
- Manage product lifecycle processes from prototyping and engineering changes through to serial production, while ensuring full traceability and documentation standards are met.

AI & Automation

- Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities from Odoo's built-in capabilities to third-party tools and custom solutions to reduce manual work and improve accuracy
- Stay current on emerging AI and automation technologies and bring relevant ideas to the table

Stellenanforderungen

- Proven experience mapping, documenting, and improving business processes with a strong understanding of how sales, procurement, inventory, production, and finance translate into system workflows

- Experience building and maintaining integrations between business systems via APIs, middleware, or native connectors, you see the full landscape and know how the pieces fit together

- Awareness of ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and export control compliance in a systems context;
- Clear communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; fluent in English, German is a plus

Why TYTAN?

jobs.description:
About the Company

CHN Energy Europe Research GmbH (CHEER) is a subsidiary of CHN Energy Investment Group (China Energy) based in Berlin, Germany. Being an integral part of China Energy’s globalized research and development layout, CHEER features in integrated European-Chinese innovation culture and advanced technology, and operates business in new energy technology research and development with purposes of promoting and accelerating carbon neutrality and making its own contribution in alleviating global climate change.

Centered on the green development strategy and the strategy of innovation-driven scientific and technological development, CHEER is committed to building a world-class research institute with global competitiveness. We focus on six key R&D areas: diversified power conversion, advanced chemical engineering, hydrogen energy, artificial intelligence, energy storage, and new environmental protection technologies.

We are building teams to develop cutting-edge sustainable and affordable technologies to improve energy efficiency, protect the environment, and mitigate climate change. Our ability to excel depends on the integrity, knowledge, skill, imagination, passion, and teamwork of people like you. Currently we have openings for leading experts with a range of focus areas including energy, chemistry, and artificial intelligence. We offer competitive compensation packages and excellent benefits.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead the development of the AI-based “Scientific Brain” research platform, including the overall construction of AI systems; apply large language models (LLMs) to design and optimize model architectures, carry out model training, and deploy the integrated AI platform.
2. Utilize robotic technologies to perform high-throughput experiments for the rapid synthesis and screening of a vast array of material candidates, accelerating the discovery of high-performance materials.
3. Analyze experimental data from material characterization techniques; correlate material properties with catalytic performance to guide the optimization of catalyst formulations and synthesis methods, thereby enhancing reaction efficiency.
4. Apply AI-driven computational modeling techniques to predict catalyst behavior at the atomic level; simulate adsorption, activation, and reaction pathways of reactants, identify promising catalyst candidates, and guide experimental work toward the most effective design directions.
5. Continuously explore and apply new AI algorithms and techniques to optimize predictive models and improve catalyst development strategies, thereby accelerating the discovery and optimization of advanced catalysts.

Qualification Requirements:

1. Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a comparable technical field
2. Several years of relevant professional experience in AI system development, platform engineering, or a comparable field
3. Solid experience in developing AI systems or scalable platforms, with sound knowledge of distributed system architectures and large-scale data processing
4. Proficiency in Python, Java, or Go
5. Practical experience with common AI frameworks and infrastructure tools, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Kubernetes, and Docker
6. Good knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, cloud platforms (such as AWS or Azure), and containerized deployment technologies
7. Additional academic or professional background in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering is considered an asset
8. Knowledge of or experience in energy, energy storage, or low-carbon technology applications is highly desirable
9. Very good English skills are required; German and/or Chinese is an advantage.

We Offer

- Competitive compensation and benefits: We offer an attractive compensation package based on the responsibilities of the role, the candidate’s qualifications, relevant professional experience, and overall fit. Additional benefits and supplementary payments may be granted in accordance with company policies and individual eligibility.
- Excellent research environment: Sufficient research funding and access to advanced digital tools and innovative technologies.
- Innovative workplace: Exciting and diverse tasks in an international R&D setting with a collaborative, open atmosphere.
- Room for creativity: Freedom to contribute your own ideas and actively shape forward-looking solutions in sustainable energy, technology, and organizational development.
- International collaboration: Interdisciplinary projects and partnerships with renowned academic and industry players across Europe, including opportunities for international exchange.
- Career development: Tailored training programs, individual career pathways, and support for participation in professional events and confe

Application process:

Please send your application documents by email to

recruitment@chnenergyeurope.com

Subject line: “[Position] – [Your Name]”.

Your application should include:

- CV (including information/listing of representative research projects for R&D positions)
- University certificates / transcripts (if available)
- Reference letters from previous employers (if available)

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your data for the purpose of the recruitment process.

All document will be treated confidentially in accordance with GDPR. We retain applications for up to six months after completion of the recruitment process, unless you give explicit consent for longer storage.

For questions regarding the position or the application process, please contact our Recruiting Team:

recruitment@chnenergyeurope.com

jobs.description:
Supply Chain Process Engineer / Project Manager (f/m/d)

- Operations Center Neuenburg 2
- 80% - 100%
- Supply Chain Management
- Englisch

As the top Swiss e-commerce platform, with a crew of over 4'000 across Switzerland, Germany, and Serbia, Galaxus is poised to move into new markets. Our driving force is our determination to keep challenging the status quo. That’s why we’re on the lookout for characters who’re passionate about making genuine improvements. We’ll give you the freedom and trust to make an impact, to grow with us and to be yourself. Act galactic. Be you.

Your journey begins at our established logistics center in Wohlen, Switzerland (2-3 days per week), where you will get to know our processes, culture, and team while contributing to the cross-site project for the new location from day one. Through targeted training, workshops, and close collaboration with experienced colleagues, you will gain the insights and support needed to successfully transition into your role.

This way you experience a fully functioning operation firsthand and actively shape the future in Neuenburg at the same time. During the ramp-up phase, you act as a pragmatic all-rounder: You tackle problems wherever they arise and resolve operational bottlenecks immediately – whether at your desk or on the shop floor.

Deine Aufgaben

- You will develop, design and optimize logistics processes for our new location in Neuenburg
- In Supply Chain Management, you constantly work to improve existing processes, optimally implement new ones, and document them appropriately
- You assess new ideas together with relevant stakeholders, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis
- You ensure proper training, documentation, and correct application of processes by regularly participating in operational logistics activities
- Depending on the situation, you assume different responsibilities during project implementation, including coordinating project teams as a project manager or independently driving optimization initiatives
- You identify optimization opportunities, initiate the necessary actions, and ensure their successful implementation

Deine Fähigkeiten

- A university degree (FH, University, ETH) in Process Management, or a related field, such as Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification
- At least 3 years of professional experience in process development or project management in an industrial or logistics environment; experience with automated systems is an advantage as well as experience with SQL
- Successfully led and implemented projects, ideally combined with experience in Lean Management
- Flexibility to work temporarily in Wohlen and later at the new logistics center in Neuenburg, along with approximately 20% travel within Switzerland
- Fluent in English and German, French is an advantage
- The capacity to adapt to ongoing changes in the work environment
- Identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing changes to enhance productivity and effectiveness

Warum startest du bei uns?

- Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practise and preach
- Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas
- Uncomplicated approach: Simplicity is at our core. We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes
- Flexibility and freedom: Every position is possible with an 80% workload
- Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with EDU points (https://www.galaxus.de/en/page/more-training-sign-me-up-20943)  (1600 € and 2000 minutes) per year for your professional development so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut
- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefits

Diversity is our culture.

To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.

Data-Warehouse GmbH is an expanding software manufacturer and service provider. Over the last 20 years the company has developed into a system house with its own product portfolios in the area of holistic, high quality information management, information logistics and process optimisation, security and cyber strategy and compliance/data protection consulting.

The job is a Senior Container Administrator role.  The environment to be managed is an air-gapped on-prem solution.  The expectation is that the candidate will also perform Unix/Linux administration activities.

The job is located in the north of Munich (on site as no remote working is possible).

German, British, Spanish or Italian nationality is required.

Tasks:

- Deploy, configure, and maintain Rancher-based container platform in an air-gapped environment.
- Manage Kubernetes clusters, nodes, and workloads within the Rancher ecosystem.
- Administer Unix-based operating systems, including performance tuning and troubleshooting.
- Implement security hardening practices for containerized environments and Unix servers.
- Automate system and container operations using scripting languages such as Ansible.
- Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery for containerized workloads.
- Design and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for both Rancher and Unix infrastructure.
- Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to support CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
- Maintain compliance with security policies, including patch management and vulnerability remediation.
- Document architecture, procedures, and operational guidelines for system administration.

Requirements/Knowledge/Experience:
- Proven experience in Rancher container orchestration and Kubernetes administration.
- Strong expertise in Unix/Linux system administration (RHEL8, RHEL9, or similar).
- Knowledge of air-gapped deployments and best practices for secure environments.
- Proficiency in infrastructure automation using Ansible, Terraform, or similar tools.
- Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Loki.
- Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills for both containers and Unix systems.
- Familiarity with container security tools and practices.
- Experience working with containerized databases and persistent storage solutions.
- Experience with version control and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, etc.).
- Certifications such as CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer), or similar is an advantage.
- Understanding of SIEM tools and security event monitoring focused on containers is an advantage.
- Working with ticket system for incidents, problems, change management and configuration management.
- Strong background in IT (working in IT).
- IT related Bachelor or Master’s degree is a plus.
- Any knowledge of ITIL would be useful.
- Knowledge of DNS and load balancers.
- Good Unix/Linux knowledge.
- Knowledge of BMC Helix would be nice to have.
- VMWare knowledge would be nice to have.
- The candidate should also be able to speak and write in English.
- Security check (Ü2) available or willing to go through the process to acquire it.
- Willingness to learn and acquire new skills (including acquiring relevant certifications).

Willingness to work in a rotation system (to cover the service hours) and to work outside working hours (usually one Saturday per month)

Your Soft Skills:

High team spirit

Reliability, punctuality

Our offer:

We offer a safe, trustful and long-term working environment with very good working conditions in an exciting working environment

Company fitness and other company events

Clear and open internal communications and fast decisions

Cultural and international mixture of leading experts in their areas

Highly innovative environment with a personal development plan

We look forward to welcoming you to our team and shaping the future.
